request.query: There exist positive natural degrees r_j greater than 10/delta with r_j log q_j balanced within factor 1+delta/10 and r_(j+1)/delta < r_j.

items.informal_name: Behrend's Lower Bound for Roth Numbers: $ N e^{-4\sqrt{\ln N}} < \text{rothNumberNat}(N) $
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ N \geq 4096 $, the Roth number of $ N $, denoted $ \text{rothNumberNat}(N) $, satisfies the inequality $ N \cdot e^{-4\sqrt{\ln N}} < \text{rothNumberNat}(N) $. This provides an explicit lower bound for the maximum size of a subset of $ \{0, 1, \ldots, N-1\} $ containing no three-term arithmetic progression.

items.informal_name: Behrend's Lower Bound for Roth Numbers
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ N $, the Roth number $ \text{rothNumberNat}(N) $ satisfies the inequality $ N \cdot e^{-4 \sqrt{\ln N}} \leq \text{rothNumberNat}(N) $.

items.informal_name: Bound on the deviation of $ r(i, n) $ from $ b(i) n $ in Akra-Bazzi recurrence
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r),
  ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (i : α), ‖↑(r i n) - b i * ↑n‖ ≤ ↑n / Real.log ↑n ^ 2
items.informal_description: For all indices $ i $ and sufficiently large natural numbers $ n $, the absolute difference between $ r(i, n) $ and $ b(i) n $ is bounded above by $ \frac{n}{(\log n)^2} $. Formally, $ |r(i, n) - b(i) n| \leq \frac{n}{(\log n)^2} $ holds eventually as $ n \to \infty $.

items.informal_name: Initial bound for Szemerédi's regularity lemma
items.informal_description: The initial bound is defined as $\max\left(7, \max\left(l, \left\lfloor \frac{\log(100 / \varepsilon^5)}{\log 4} \right\rfloor + 1\right)\right)$, where $\varepsilon$ is a positive real parameter and $l$ is a natural number representing the minimum number of parts in the partition.

items.informal_name: Eventual Inequality for Akra-Bazzi Recurrence Coefficients
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (i : α), b i * ↑n - ↑n / Real.log ↑n ^ 2 ≤ ↑(r i n)
items.informal_description: For all sufficiently large natural numbers $ n $ and for each index $ i $, the inequality $ b_i n - \frac{n}{(\log n)^2} \leq r_i(n) $ holds, where $ b_i $ and $ r_i(n) $ are parameters of the Akra-Bazzi recurrence.

items.informal_name: Behrend's Bound Inequality for Exponential and d-Value
items.informal_description: For any natural number $N \geq 4096$, the inequality $\frac{N^{1/\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil}}{e} < \left\lfloor \frac{N^{1/\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil}}{2} \right\rfloor$ holds, where $\lceil \sqrt{\ln N} \rceil$ is Behrend's n-value and the right-hand side is Behrend's d-value for $N$.

items.informal_name: Eventual Linear Lower Bound for the Function `r` in an Akra-Bazzi Recurrence
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r), ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1, ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (i : α), c * ↑n ≤ ↑(r i n)
items.informal_description: Given an Akra-Bazzi recurrence with a function `r : α → ℕ → ℕ`, where `α` is a finite index set, there exists a real constant `c` in the open interval `(0, 1)` such that for all sufficiently large natural numbers `n`, the inequality `c * n ≤ r(i, n)` holds for all indices `i ∈ α`.

items.informal_name: Eventual Lower Bound on Recurrence Coefficients in Akra-Bazzi Recurrence
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] {T : ℕ → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : α → ℝ} {r : α → ℕ → ℕ} [inst_1 : Nonempty α]
  (R : AkraBazziRecurrence T g a b r) (C : ℝ), ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop, ∀ (i : α), C ≤ ↑(r i n)
items.informal_description: For all sufficiently large natural numbers $ n $, and for every index $ i $, the coefficient $ r_i(n) $ is greater than or equal to the constant $ C $.
